rows.question: Where should I start?

About the reader: Computational neuroscientist. I work on predictive processing and interoception.
Why they are reading this piece: I want to check how he gets from the brain being a prediction machine to AI not being conscious: the steps of the argument, not the overview.
rows.text:
Skip the biases and the Turing history. Your chain lives in "Life Matters": he concedes up front there's no knock-down argument [spya-hj5y6s], then moves from prediction to bodily regulation [spya-b59nm2], to metabolism [spya-vys3vj], to his three-part convergence [spya-da9tvt]. The final step, simulation versus instantiation, is [spya-pbcr03].
